spans.title: A Battleship in the Files
spans.blurb: A safecracking agent picks his chief's bedroom lock at midnight to show him proof that someone is quietly building a warship extinct for a thousand years.

spans.title: Silver from the Bay of Bengal
spans.blurb: By the hot Indian surf, a painter watches a boy ride a log through breakers while a whole village hauls in the glittering catch of the season.

spans.title: An Incredible Testimony
spans.blurb: A dusty young journalist rides hard to reach a mountain cabin inquest, where he must swear under oath to an account he himself calls incredible.

spans.title: Something in the Wild Oats
spans.blurb: Two hunters cross a quail meadow when the wild oats begin to bend and flatten under something no eye can see, and one of them raises his gun.
spans.spoilerNote: It shows the invisible creature's attack that the full story approaches sideways through its inquest frame, though the final explanation is not given.
spans.brokenNote: The passage stops mid-sentence in its final line, cutting the climax short.

books.pairNote: The short is the inquest frame and the story is the testimony given there; separate scenes that complement rather than repeat.

spans.title: Nooses by the Roadside
spans.blurb: Bandits swarm a moonlit Roman road and seize two young gentlemen, one wounded, one owing a death, while nooses are already swinging from the trees.

spans.title: A Vow in the Moonlight
spans.blurb: Hidden beneath a plane tree at night, a man watches a golden haired girl step from a carriage, and she turns as if he had called her name.

spans.title: Nerve Enough to Own the World
spans.blurb: A brindled intruder strolls in, starts a fight, absorbs a kicking without blinking, and comes away with the household ham and every shred of dignity in the room.

spans.title: Saving the Distance
spans.blurb: An old preacher and his stiff old pacer face three sleek trotters before a jeering grandstand, needing only to survive the first heat with their distance saved.

books.pairNote: A parlour dog comedy and a horse race heat; different scenes with different stakes, sharing only one bystander.

spans.title: Chichibio and the Crane
spans.blurb: A cook gives away one leg of his master's roasted crane and swears cranes have only one, a lie he must prove by the riverside at dawn.

spans.title: We Are Friends
spans.blurb: A stranded explorer plants himself in the path of a headless barrel creature pushing a cart, holds out both hands, and offers friendship.

spans.title: The Forbidden Parlour
spans.blurb: A toddler slips at last into the forbidden parlour on a cold morning and finds his mother lying still among flowers, resting for the first time.

spans.title: The Ship From Outside
spans.blurb: A tiny patrol ship near Pluto meets a stranger half a mile long, and its crew begin dying in perfect silence while two men run for the tender.
